name: Ricardo Benavides
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching rally races in the mountains near his hometown. He initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, hoping to become a race engineer, but quickly realized his organizational skills were better suited for logistics. He started his career managing parts inventory for a small karting team before joining GCK Motorsport two years ago. Ricardo prides himself on his meticulous approach, ensuring every component and piece of equipment is in the right place at the right time. He believes that seamless logistics are the unsung heroes of any successful racing team.

Since joining GCK Motorsport, Ricardo has been instrumental in streamlining their supply chain and improving the efficiency of their race weekend operations. He's known for his ability to anticipate potential problems and proactively develop solutions. His dedication and attention to detail have earned him the respect of his colleagues. He’s particularly adept at managing the complex transport schedules required for international rally events, a skill he developed during his time backpacking across Europe after completing his degree.

Ricardo's loyalty to the team is unwavering, and he's always willing to go the extra mile to ensure their success. He views his role as more than just a job; it's a commitment to helping GCK Motorsport achieve its goals. This dedication, combined with his engineering background, makes him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing practical, team-branded clothing.

quirks: Organizes his desk strictly by color and size.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down potential logistical improvements.
Has a habit of double-checking every item on his checklists, even if he just confirmed it moments before.
